(In the end, wasn't everything I've been
doing just calculation aimed at
know-it-all adults...?)
theater_event_23_06_09_337:
(Yes... Not one child even glances at our
sculpture. That alone proves it.)
theater_event_23_06_09_340:
Destroying a sculpture we spent so much time
and effort on...and having to tell
the members that—
theater_event_23_06_09_341:
And on top of that, I can't even see
anything concrete I should create
afterward...
theater_event_23_06_09_342:
All I have is the urgency of "not this"—
the sense of duty that I must make
"a work yet unseen"—
theater_event_23_06_09_343:
If the ultimate is "a work no one has ever
seen"—one that captivates gods, adults,
and children alike...
theater_event_23_06_09_344:
To aim for the ultimate...I must be willing
to "destroy" what we have now...to cast
aside my members' devotion—
theater_event_23_06_09_347:
Somebody call a healer!
We have to get the captain home, fast—!
theater_event_23_06_10_351:
Aye. We'd just brought the snow into
Orario when Ais told us you'd collapsed.
theater_event_23_06_10_353:
...! I can't just lie here.
I have to get to the sculpture—
theater_event_23_06_10_357:
...All-nighters are standard practice for
creators. If anything, they're good
stimulation for fresh perspectives.
theater_event_23_06_10_358:
Don't make light of this. If you can't even
see the faces of the members worried about
you...then it's serious.
theater_event_23_06_10_359:
Worrying everyone who's working for you
like this... Can you truly say you're
doing your best work?
theater_event_23_06_10_361:
Rest for once.
If it's for the sake of your creation,
what you need is rest.
theater_event_23_06_10_362:
I don't know about art, but when it comes
to making things, you'll hardly ever make
anything good when you're worn out.
theater_event_23_06_10_365:
Ais...tell everyone for me.
I'm sorry I let them see me
in such a sorry state.
theater_event_23_06_10_367:
And...finish the sculpture however
you all see fit.
theater_event_23_06_10_369:
I went around looking at all sorts of
sculptures...and burned so many
wonderful ones into my eyes.
theater_event_23_06_10_370:
Any idea I come up with will just be
"something I've seen before"—
a knockoff of someone else's.
theater_event_23_06_10_371:
A work no one has ever seen... Unfortunately,
no matter how I struggle, I can't come up
with anything new right now.
theater_event_23_06_10_372:
I'm sorry to do this at the last minute...
but from here on, I can't do it alone...
theater_event_23_06_10_375:
Leave it to us...
We'll finish your work, Finn—
theater_event_23_06_10_377:
Hey, you there!
No slacking off!
theater_event_23_06_10_378:
Listen up, all of you! The captain trusted us
with this! Do a half-baked job,
and I'll send you flying!
theater_event_23_06_10_380:
Ahaha... She might be scarier
than the captain...
theater_event_23_06_10_381:
But...I like it better this way.
It feels like we're all building
it together...
theater_event_23_06_10_382:
Yeah, yeah!
All right! Everyone, let's make something
awesome and surprise Finn!
theater_event_23_06_11_385: Yes, I think...it turned out well!
theater_event_23_06_11_386:
Yes, the captain's sure to like this.
Now all we have to do is wait
for him to recover.
theater_event_23_06_11_388:
What's wrong, Ms. Ais?
Is there something you're not
happy with...?
theater_event_23_06_11_389:
No...
I just think...it's nice. A sculpture
we all worked hard on.
theater_event_23_06_11_390:
Right?!
I like it as much as my Urga!
theater_event_23_06_11_393:
Ahaha, come to think of it, we've been working
nonstop lately without even taking
time to eat.
theater_event_23_06_11_394:
The sculpture's done, so why don't we
go eat something tasty to celebrate?
theater_event_23_06_11_395:
I'm in!
An early Holy Night celebration!
theater_event_23_06_11_397:
—Ais. What are you spacing out for?
Let's go.
theater_event_23_06_11_398:
...Okay.
But I think...I want to look at it
a little longer.
theater_event_23_06_11_399:
...I see. Then come after you've looked
a bit more. We'll save you a share.
theater_event_23_06_11_405:
You'll never catch me!
Heh heh! Wheee—
theater_event_23_06_11_409:
Y-yeah!
But the god's snow sculpture...
I broke it!!
theater_event_23_06_11_410:
My mom said this was super important.
She said if we broke it, we'd get in
super big trouble...
theater_event_23_06_11_411:
Huh, wh-what... Waaaaaah!
I'm sorry, I'm sorry! I...!
theater_event_23_06_11_414:
Mm. Finn asked me to look after it...
so leave it to me.
theater_event_23_06_11_420:
Huh? Is it...weird?
Then over here—
theater_event_23_06_12_423:
I hear there are a lot of impressive works this
year. I thought being head judge would
be a pain, but...
theater_event_23_06_12_424: This looks like it'll be worth judging.
theater_event_23_06_12_426:
Well, let's get the judging started already.
Looks like the children can't wait either.
theater_event_23_06_12_427:
Yes. First up...the sculpture by
Demeter's children. Remove the veil...!
theater_event_23_06_12_428:
Whoooooa!! What an impressive likeness...!!
That's Demeter, all right! I feel like I'm
gonna get crushed just looking at it!!
theater_event_23_06_12_429: Stop staring at the vulgar parts.
theater_event_23_06_12_430:
—Yes. It's crafted down to the finest detail...
A wonderful piece that shows deep love
for Demeter.
theater_event_23_06_12_431:
Everyone really did make
amazing sculptures...
theater_event_23_06_12_432:
Sure did.
Finn, so what happened with our
sculpture in the end?
theater_event_23_06_12_433:
...That's a surprise for when
it's unveiled. For you...and for me.
theater_event_23_06_12_435:
Um... About that...
I need to...talk to you...
theater_event_23_06_12_438:
The excitement's on another level for the
favorite. —Next up, the Goibniu Familia!
theater_event_23_06_12_441:
C'mon, show us a soul-shaking masterpiece!
Here goes! Unveiling—
theater_event_23_06_12_447:
No matter how many times we smashed it! No
matter how many times we rebuilt it! The boss's
expression never so much as twitched!
theater_event_23_06_12_448:
We're so sorry, Boss!
We couldn't make anything that would
satisfy youuuu!!
theater_event_23_06_12_449:
(Like I said...I never told
these guys anything to begin with...)
theater_event_23_06_12_450:
...The higher your ideal, the harder it is to
compromise, huh. Every craftsman walks
that road.
theater_event_23_06_12_453:
Hmm. In the Far East, there is the idea of
"the state of nothingness"—that one reaches
nothingness at the end of mastery.
theater_event_23_06_12_454:
By that measure, you could say the nothing
here is the very art the Goibniu Familia
has attained.
theater_event_23_06_12_455: Hmmmmm. Is that how it works?
theater_event_23_06_12_457:
Man, the Orario Snow Festival is the best.
Though I seriously jumped when Ganesha
burst out of his sculpture.
theater_event_23_06_12_458:
The Hestia Familia's tiny one wasn't bad either!
The little kids went wild over it.
theater_event_23_06_12_459: Ais, what's this about the sculpture?
theater_event_23_06_12_462:
OPEN THE CURTAAAAAAIN!!
Behold the work of the city's greatest
familia, the Loki Familia!!
theater_event_23_06_12_465:
Wh-wh-wh...WHAT THE HECK?!
What is THIS?!
theater_event_23_06_13_469:
Wh-wh-wh-what is THIS?!
Why's it all a gigantic mess?!
theater_event_23_06_13_470: It didn't look like this the other day!
theater_event_23_06_13_472:
The sculpture broke...and when I tried
to fix it...one thing led to another...
theater_event_23_06_13_473:
No, no! How do ya mess with it to end up like
THIS? There's nothin' left of me!
theater_event_23_06_13_477:
Never thought I'd see something like this
in the mortal world...
theater_event_23_06_13_478:
Yes... To think there was a child in the mortal
world who'd create abstract art...
no, an abstract snow sculpture...
theater_event_23_06_13_479:
Knew it'd get wild...
The mortal art world's about to get
interesting.
theater_event_23_06_13_480:
I can't make heads or tails of it.
Is that thing really worth such
high praise?
theater_event_23_06_13_481:
Who knows. It's clearly unlike any art
I've ever seen. But—
theater_event_23_06_13_484:
Loki's divinity as a being feared in the
heavens, and her divinity as a trickster
who entertains others—
theater_event_23_06_13_485:
Loki's nearly contradictory divinities,
cleverly expressed so that you sense
both. That much is certain—
theater_event_23_06_13_486:
THIS is Loki! Loki herself, which only
the children who've watched her up close
could express!
theater_event_23_06_13_487:
Not realism, but simplifying the elements
in one's mind and conveying only the
impression in a concise form—
theater_event_23_06_13_488:
Truly an ultimate no one has ever seen!
What must be destroyed is one's own common
sense! A masterpiece born of true courage!
theater_event_23_06_13_489:
Um... I was only trying to fix
the broken statue...
theater_event_23_06_13_490:
Hold your head high, Ais.
The work you created deserves to be
known across the world—!
theater_event_23_06_13_492: And the winner is the Loki Familia!
theater_event_23_06_13_495:
Winnin's great and all, but somethin'
about this don't sit right!
It ain't pretty OR cute at all!
theater_event_23_06_13_496:
Now, now, don't say that. From what I hear,
even the gods are split on it.
theater_event_23_06_13_497:
Yeah, yeah, isn't it great?
First time entering,
first time winning!
theater_event_23_06_13_498:
It means even the gods recognize
Ms. Ais's talent!
theater_event_23_06_13_499:
Though it seems utterly impossible
to reproduce...
theater_event_23_06_13_501:
Our first step in mecenat is "complete"—!
From here, we aim for even greater heights,
in name and in substance!
theater_event_23_06_13_503:
Celebrating the win is fine and all...
but I reckon it's about time we cooled
Finn's head off on a snowy mountain...
theater_event_23_06_13_504:
That'd be fine, if he were the type
a little cold could cure...
theater_event_23_06_13_505: I shall question you all on art!!
theater_event_23_07_01_001:
Some time after Bell and the others'
desperate battle on the 18th floor—
theater_event_23_07_01_004:
I wonder if Riveria and the others
are on the 18th floor by now...?
theater_event_23_07_01_009:
Crystal Drop candies...!
I finally found them!
theater_event_23_07_01_010: Hee hee... With these, Ms. Ais will...
theater_event_23_07_01_011: M-Ms. Ais, these are for you...!
theater_event_23_07_01_012:
These...are my favorite, the ones you brought
me before, Lefiya... Did you go all the way

theater_event_23_07_01_013:
Y-yes...!
I wanted you to taste them,
Ms. Ais...!
theater_event_23_07_01_014:
I think I might like these
even more than Jyaga Maru-kun now...
theater_event_23_07_01_018: Oh my gosh! Oh my goooosh!!
theater_event_23_07_01_023:
What are you doing?! Skulking around
hiding in the bushes...!
theater_event_23_07_01_024:
Ah?! Don't tell me you're peeping

theater_event_23_07_01_025:
Shh...! It's nothing like that,

theater_event_23_07_01_026:
Huh...? You're blatantly skulking around!
And that black battle cloth...
it's for lurking around like a creep...!
theater_event_23_07_01_027:
It's a coincidence...! Please be quiet...!
If you put it that way, you're wearing
something similar too...
theater_event_23_07_01_028:
You call the battle cloth Lady Riveria gave me a

I'll turn you into even blacker charcoal!
theater_event_23_07_01_031:
Excuse me?! Of all things, you want to
make me your accomplice?!
You shameless, sleazy rabbit!
theater_event_23_07_01_032:
Th-that's not it!
Just get over here, quick!
theater_event_23_07_01_034:
Hm... I could've sworn
someone was there...?
theater_event_23_07_01_035:
Sorry, guess it was my imagination.
Well then, shall we go—
theater_event_23_07_01_038:
C'mon, unfriendly as ever, huh?
You could at least tell me
where we're goin', right?
theater_event_23_07_01_039:
Eh, I don't care where we go,
gwahahaha!
theater_event_23_07_01_041:
A-actually, I...followed those two here...
It kinda felt like what the gods call
a "date"...
